summary: BGM Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its July 9, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, where shareholders approved resolutions including a share consolidation, post-consolidation share capital increase, capital reduction and reorganization, and adoption of new memorandum and articles. The board is authorized to implement these changes over three years. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter involving capital structure adjustments, not an event-driven special situation, so it is classified as None. No deal terms are stated.
